summary: Neighbors at a crime meeting talk about being next and ask for patrols and alarms.
realLife: Residents at two meetings said the recent run of break-ins made them anxious, asked for more patrols in named areas, suggested alarms and cameras, and some said the criminals seemed bolder than before.
